artifacts.importance: omitted (this experiment makes no feature-importance claim)

baseline.definition: per-target median of the outer-training labels, applied once to each outer_test row
baseline.skillDefinition: skill_af30(model) = 1 - mae_af30(model) / mae_af30(median) over the same pooled OOF rows; the median model's own skill is 0 by construction

equivalence.criterion: max |prediction difference| < 1e-9 over every outer fold
equivalence.note: rank 50 with gamma = 0 uses the same normal matrix and the same intercept as ridge

oofDefinition.rule: (repeat, outer_fold, beer) with role=inner IS the training set of that fold; a beer predicted in that fold must never appear in it

definition.mae: A/F30 equal-weight mean of |y_true - y_pred| over the CONCATENATED OOF rows (1 repeat(s) x 250 beers = 250 rows); it is NOT the mean of per-repeat scores
definition.oof: a beer's prediction comes from the model fitted on that beer's outer-fold training rows; the beer is in that fold's outer_test set and was in no fit, no imputation median, no standardisation, no graph, no tuning decision and no grading cut point
definition.predictionsCsv: 250 rows per repeat for the candidate graph-lowrank model; predictions_all_models.csv has all four models and oof_long.csv has every (beer, target, model) row

devNotes.provenance: separate exploratory run, NOT part of this artifact
devNotes.result: ridge, inner pooled AF30 MAE averaged over the same 9 outer folds: lambda=1 -> 0.3763, 10 -> 0.3701, 30 -> 0.3848, 100 -> 0.4000, 300 -> 0.4077; zscore shows the same shape. lambda=10 is therefore an interior optimum and the frozen grid {0.1,1,10} is not truncated, even though 10 is its largest value
rank 6 is selected in 9/9 outer folds within the prescribed grid {3,6,10}; ranks 3 and 10 are never chosen, so the rank is stable but the grid is coarse (see selectionDiagnostics)

excluded.why: separable nonlinear probe; out of scope for this Q1 repair, left to a later experiment
the fused pipeline was the v5.1 source of in-sample/holdout mixing; not reused here
B = A^{-1} C Vr Vr^T (eigenvectors of C^T A^{-1} C) is the exact minimiser, so the 25-sweep ALS of the legacy code is NOT used and nothing about low rank is skipped

excluded.item: PSD projection of the Laplacian (legacy eigenvalue clipping)
excluded.why: L = diag(sum|W|) - W is PSD by Gershgorin, so clipping silently changed the penalty; the measured minimum eigenvalue is recorded per fold as evidence instead
no external evaluation set exists; every number here is internal nested CV

fixes.protocol: frozen NESTED-CV-1 splits via v6_common.iter_outer / iter_inner, no local fold drawing
fixes.ridgeIsOrdinaryRidge: gamma = 0 and r = 50; the v5.1 'ridge' was a gamma = 1 graph ridge and now appears separately as graph-ridge
fixes.trueOOF: every beer is predicted by a model that never saw it; q1_grade_all.py's in-sample 200-row predictions are not reused
fixes.uniformIntercept: every model uses b = ybar - zbar B; the legacy low-rank model refreshed the intercept every ALS sweep while its ridge reference held the label mean fixed

equivalence.criterion: max |prediction difference| < 1e-9 over every outer fold

protocol.gradeRule: F = mid-rank empirical CDF of the outer-training labels; g = clip(floor(6F(y)+0.5),0,6); the observed outer_test label goes through the same F, so this is RELATIVE grade consistency only
protocol.interceptRule: b = ybar - zbar @ B for ridge, graph-ridge and graph-lowrank
protocol.lowrankSolver: A = Zc^T Zc/n + lambda I + gamma L (Cholesky), C = Zc^T Yc/n, B = A^{-1} C Vr Vr^T with Vr the leading r eigenvectors of C^T A^{-1} C; no explicit inverse, no ALS sweeps
protocol.metricKeyConvention: nested blocks are flattened with '__' (per_group__<name>__mae, per_style__<name>__mae, per_fold__r<r>f<f>__mae) because modeling_contract.emit_metrics accepts finite numbers only
protocol.randomness: none: no RNG draw anywhere; every fold comes from the frozen splits.csv
protocol.selectionRule: inner 3-fold CV inside each outer training set; candidates are scored by the equal-weight MAE over the CONCATENATED validation rows (not the mean of per-fold scores); the winner is refitted on the whole outer training set
